Name: Eyelashes
Description: This will create an eyelash system over the eye block

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create an eyelash system over the eye block. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. EyeName: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl.
